"}, {"number": 11, "date": "2024-02-12T06:40:03.000Z", "text": " If you’re importing a .csv that will overwrite and update a product, but it needs NO changes to the existing variant images, make sure to delete that entire column of variant images from your spreadsheet before import. This will avoid the error where a product with perfectly fine variant images suddenly stops working. Because the variant image column is removed, Shopify will not attempt to overwrite the existing column with any of your “new” data. So it will be left alone, and won’t have the chance to fail.

The images in this column are not linked to any variant, not even the one that just happens to be on the same row of the .csv sheet.
